messages:
Support Agent: heads up — getting a flurry of support tickets since ~02:50 UTC complaining about embeddings API. Two categories: 1) "dimension mismatch" errors for existing customers after last rollout, 2) elevated 503s / high latency on embeddings/predict. Example error from a customer: {"error":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 but got 1024"}

Support Agent: repro steps the customer provided (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-large","input":"hello world"}'
```
They say this used to return a 1536-d vector, now fails with the mismatch. Also seeing ~15% 503s and p95 latency jump to 3.2s for embeddings route. Ticket numbers: #1234, #1237, #1241.

Alice Chen: thanks — tagging eng-runtime and infra. Any recent model deployments or config changes? Can someone grab traces and the service deploy history? :eyes:

devon: @devon here, just pulled deploy logs — deploy-bot shows embed-service rollout at 02:58 UTC: embed-service:v3-compact -> replaced text-embed-large-v2 variants. Might be a model variant with different output dim. Adding logs: deploy-bot: "deploy embed-service:v3-compact started 2024-11-15T02:58:10Z"

eng-runtime-oncall: I'm looking at metrics now. Observations:
- sudden increase in batching queue length on pool-embed-eu-west-1 from ~200 to ~1400 concurrent batches after 02:58
- KV cache eviction rate spiked (weird)
- error rate for embeddings endpoint peaked at 18% 02:58–03:10
- traced a few request ids, saw router returning 502/503 from worker when model returned shorter vector and post-processing validation failed.

Samir Patel: I can reproduce locally against staging replica of the new binary. Running the same curl returns a 1024-d vector and our validation layer raises: "dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024" — looks like the model artifact itself outputs 1024. Repro command:
```
# local reproduce
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-large","input":["a","b"]}' | jq .
```
output snippet:
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 but got 1024"
}

Maria Lopez: product confirms we intended to serve a compact variant (v3-compact) behind the same model alias for cost savings, but we failed to update model catalog metadata to reflect new dim=1024. That's a catalog drift issue — customers rely on stable vector dims.

Kevin Zhao: throttling applied to embeddings route to reduce error propagation and give us breathing room. I added a temporary 30% rate limit (scope: anonymous/platinum tiers excluded) and raised queue timeouts to avoid worker overload.

Support Agent: a few customers requested immediate rollback if possible — their pipelines assume 1536 dims. What are options?

eng-runtime-oncall: we have two immediate options: 1) rollback model alias to previous artifact that returns 1536, or 2) update model catalog so API returns a compatibility error and we serve the compact variant only on a new model id. For minimum customer impact, rollback is safest.

deploy-bot: "rollback embed-service to embed-service:v2-stable initiated by Alice Chen at 03:18:42Z"

Devon Park: initiating rollback now — patching model alias mapping and restarting the embed pool with v2-stable. This should flip outputs back to 1536 dims. I'll watch queues.

ops-bot: notice — embed pool drain started 03:19:05Z, evicting new requests from compact nodes.

Samir Patel: after rollback completed (03:22) I re-ran the repro against prod: now embeddings return 1536-d vectors and the earlier mismatch error is gone for my test keys. Also seeing error rate drop on the dashboard to ~1.2%.

Support Agent: relaying to customers: rolling back to previous model variant; please confirm with tickets. Also will offer help migrating to compact variant via a new model id once we publish dimensional change.

Maria Lopez: action items:
- patch: model catalog must include output_dim metadata and a validation gate on alias rollouts (PR in product/mc)
- infra: add an integration test that runs a small inference after deploy to confirm vector dims match catalog (eng-runtime)
- cli/sdk: throw a warning if a client pins alias and vector dim changes (deprecation flow)

Kevin Zhao: I'll keep the temporary rate limiting in place for 1 hour and then ramp down after we confirm stability. Also added an alert to paging logic to include the catalog owner on any alias-to-artifact rollouts.

Alice Chen: excellent. Postmortem timeline please and assign owners for the follow-ups. Everyone who touched this thread: please add short notes to the incident doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/EMB-2024-11-15)

Devon Park: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = model alias rollout replaced artifact with different embedding size; contributing = no dim validation test and catalog metadata not authoritative; mitigation = rollback; long-term = rollout gating, automated dim-check to stage.

Support Agent: customers #1234 & #1241 confirmed success after rollback, will keep #1237 open for 24h to validate.

eng-runtime-oncall: monitoring p95 is back to baseline (0.4s) and 503s under 0.5% now. Closing this thread but reopening if any residual errors surface. :white_check_mark:

Alice Chen: thanks all — please follow through on the three assigned PRs. We should also add a small note to the changelog about model alias behavior so support isn't surprised next time.

Samir Patel: adding repro snippet + logs to the incident doc now.

deploy-bot: "rollback completed: embed-service:v2-stable active (completion 03:24:38Z)"

Kevin Zhao: leaving rate-limit in place until 04:30 UTC. I'll post update when removed.

Alice Chen: nice work. Emoji reactions: :shipit: :heart:
